blind_spots_patched: Omitted PipeBox LLC's asymmetric 60%/40% cash waterfall ($3.3B remaining Base Return), $13.2B off-balance-sheet firm pipeline/processing commitments, $590M uncommenced 2028 LNG vessel leases, $3.5B Oct 2026 commercial paper program, and accurate Fitch Stable rating.

Omitted that 94% of upstream accounts receivable sit with non-end-user intermediaries/marketers, ~51% of sales volume remains in-basin, and 1.2 Bcf/d of 2027 MVP firm sales depend on Transco Southeast Supply Enhancement.

Omitted 2026 Form 4 insider selling (366,950 shares sold, zero open-market buys), zero Q3 2026 buybacks ahead of Dec 31, 2026 authorization expiry, TSR-only LTIP PSUs lacking ROIC hurdles, and re-added 10% production weight in 2025 STIP.

Omitted HSR antitrust divestiture obligations and EQT's asymmetric $1,148M reverse break-up fee on the Range merger (~25% Marcellus share), plus the 245% YoY jump in 9M 2026 legal/environmental reserves ($87.1M).

Omitted fixed take-or-pay pipeline demand charges (~$1.1B/yr) continuing during shut-ins, $191M 9M 2026 basis/liquids hedge cash losses, 11% YoY LOE/SG&A creep to $0.10/Mcfe, and 2027 3-way collar exposure below $2.50/Dth.
assumptions_changed: CONFIRMED: EQT cut consolidated debt from ~$14B post-Equitrans peak down to $5.6B ($5.5B net debt) by September 30, 2026.
WEAKENED: EQT's LNG export portfolio consists of 2.5 MTPA of 20-year SPAs (1.5 MTPA NextDecade + 1.0 MTPA Commonwealth LNG).
WEAKENED: Management avoids rigid swaps that cap upside, favoring wide costless collars (~$3.94/MMBtu floor in 2026 and ~9 MMDth in Q1 2027), while LOE declined Q/Q in Q3 2026.
WEAKENED: Rising U.S. LNG exports tighten North American gas balances enough to counter Permian associated gas supply growth.

CONFIRMED: EQT's Q3 2026 operational KPIs delivered $1.09/Mcfe operating costs, $638M capex (~10% below guidance), and $1,083M operating cash flow while Range integration advances toward Q1 2027 close.
WEAKENED: Blackstone's 49% PipeBox LLC stake simply deducts ~$287M/yr of non-controlling interest net income, and both S&P and Fitch raised EQT's credit outlook to Positive in 2026.
